_comment: Read a steady EXTERNAL DC voltage on CH1 (from the ECM, a supply, a battery, etc.). DC coupling is essential (AC coupling would strip the level away). AUTO trigger because a flat line has no edge to trigger on. The timebase is irrelevant for DC, so a fast 1 ms/div is fine; the level is taken as the mean over the record. CH1 5 V/div covers roughly +/-20 V, enough for automotive levels (e.g. 14 V). For small logic levels (3.3 / 5 V) drop the scale for finer resolution; for higher voltages raise it. 1 MOhm input so it is safe well beyond 20 V.
name: dc_read
